DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 音が広く聞こえていますので、少し下げていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The sound is carrying quite far. Could you lower it a little?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勉強の音声です。音楽ではなくても下げた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学習音声も音量配慮が必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is study audio. Should I lower it even though it is not music?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether study audio also requires volume consideration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容にかかわらず、近くで休んでいる方へ配慮をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whatever the content, please consider people resting nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。聞き取るため大きくしていましたが、一度止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再生を一度止めると応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I turned it up to hear clearly, but I will stop it for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Respond that you will stop playback for now. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。静かに歩く方法でもお楽しみいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. You can also enjoy a quiet walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: イヤホンならよいですか。ただ、周囲の声が聞こえなくなるのも心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: イヤホン使用と周囲の音への不安を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Would headphones be okay? But I am also worried I might not hear voices around me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about headphones and concern over surrounding sounds. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使用の案内に従い、周囲に気付ける音量にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow the usage guidance and keep the volume low enough to notice your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は音声を止めて散歩します。勉強は帰宅してから続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 散歩中は再生をやめると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will turn the audio off and walk today. I will continue studying after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to stop playback while walking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方が周囲を見ながら歩けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That lets you walk while watching your surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にも再生を止めたと伝えます。ベンチの人の前では声も控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者へ中止を伝え周囲へ配慮する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell my friend I stopped playback too. I will also keep my voice down in front of people on benches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your companion you stopped and consider others. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11233-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for cooperating. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人でホームへ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you both going to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人は車椅子です。私は階段で先に行って、上で待とうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車椅子同行者と別経路を考えていると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend uses a wheelchair. I was thinking of going ahead by the stairs and waiting upstairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are considering separate routes from your wheelchair-using companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 経路が分かれると行き違いになることがあります。一緒に使える道をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Taking separate routes can lead to missing each other. I will show you a route you can use together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ではエレベーターまで付き添います。友人が自分で動けるので、勝手に押さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一緒に移動し無断で押さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will accompany my friend to the elevator. They can move independently, so I will not push without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will travel together and not push without permission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な手伝いはご本人へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask your friend what help they need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は扉を開ける時だけ手伝ってほしいそうです。どの通路へ進めばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の希望する手伝いと経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend says they only want help opening doors. Which passage should we take?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about your companion's requested help and the route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内に沿って左です。幅のある扉を通ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow this sign to the left. You will pass through a wide door.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左の通路ですね。途中で友人と離れず、表示を一緒に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者と表示を確認して進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The left passage, right? I will stay with my friend and check the signs together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Proceed while checking signs with your companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ホームでの乗車支援が必要なら、こちらへご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need boarding assistance on the platform, please ask here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗る時の支援は友人に聞いてから頼みます。まず二人でホームまで行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車支援は本人に確認後頼むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will request boarding assistance after asking my friend. First we will both go to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to request boarding help only after checking with the person. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な時に係員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Ask a staff member when needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この資料も確認が必要ですが、お持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: We need to check this document too. Do you have it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にあります。すぐ取りに戻って、同じ番号で続けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忘れた資料を取りに帰る希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is at home. Can I go back for it right away and continue using the same number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to go home for a forgotten document. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の受付の扱いを確認します。戻るまでどのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check how your current reception is handled. How long until you return?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 往復で四十分です。閉庁までには戻れますが、受付の締切は別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 戻る所要時間と受付締切を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Forty minutes round trip. I can return before the office closes, but is the reception deadline different?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about your return time and the reception deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 締切と担当の対応状況をご案内します。戻れば必ずすぐ続けられるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the deadline and staff availability. Returning does not necessarily mean you can resume immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、今日の申請はどこまで進んだか控えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今の申請進捗を控えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I would like a record of how far today's application has progressed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a record of the current application progress. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認済みの項目と不足資料を、この紙に記載します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will write the items already checked and missing documents on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。次に来る時はこの紙も見せます。番号札は返した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足資料の案内を持参し番号札の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will show this paper next time. Should I return the number ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the missing-document guidance and ask about the number ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今の受付をいったん終えるので、こちらへお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We are ending the current reception for now, so please return it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返します。書類をそろえて、受付時間を確認してから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付を終え資料をそろえて戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. I will gather the documents, check reception hours and then return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to end reception, gather the documents and return. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当名と不足資料の案内を忘れずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Remember to bring the staff member's name and missing-document guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の確認ですね。診察券をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are checking an appointment. Your patient card, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、留守電に変更希望を入れました。返信がないので、新しい日に行ってよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信のない留守電変更の成立を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday I left a voicemail asking for a change. There has been no reply, so I want to ask whether I may come on the new date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether an unanswered voicemail appointment change has taken effect. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 希望を伝えた時刻と、元の予約日を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me when you left the message and the original appointment date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日六時、元は水曜日です。金曜日を希望すると話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 連絡時刻と元の日と希望日を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday at six. The original was Wednesday. I said I wanted Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State contact time, original date and requested date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 留守電の連絡だけで、金曜日の枠が確定したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Leaving a voicemail alone does not confirm a Friday slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。金曜日が取れないなら、別の日も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望日不可なら別日相談に応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. If Friday is unavailable, I can discuss another date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to discuss another day if the requested date is unavailable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に記録と空きを確認します。日中の連絡先はこの番号でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask the responsible staff to check records and availability. Is this number okay for daytime contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。留守電には氏名だけで診察券番号を入れ忘れたので、ここで伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号を入れ忘れたと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I left only my name in the voicemail and forgot my patient card number, so I will give it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add that you forgot to include the number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。本人の予約と照合しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. That will make it easier to match your appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更結果を聞いてから予定を直します。今は元の予約がどうなっているかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の予約と変更結果の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will change my plans after hearing the result. Please also check the status of my original appointment now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the original appointment and change result. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両方を担当へ確認してご連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check both with the responsible staff and contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらない場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where is the bicycle missing from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住んでいるアパートの駐輪場です。昨日、整理作業があったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共有駐輪場の不在と整理作業を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bicycle parking area at my apartment building. It seems there was a clearing operation yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the missing bicycle in shared parking and the clearing work. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理者へご確認になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked with the manager?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話しましたが担当が不在でした。掲示に移動先の案内はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理会社に確認できていない状況を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I called, but the responsible person was away. The notice does not say where items were moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you have not been able to confirm with the management company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 整理された物か、ほかの理由かはまだ分からないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you do not yet know whether it was cleared away or there is another reason.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。盗まれたと決めてはいません。ただ今日使うので、確認を進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 盗難と断定せず必要な確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. I have not decided it was stolen. But I need it today and want to move the checks forward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid declaring theft and ask for necessary checks. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理会社へ確認した内容と、ご自身の自転車の特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask what you checked with management and your bicycle's features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀色で登録番号の控えがあります。駐輪許可のシールも付けていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録情報と許可シールを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is silver, and I have a copy of the registration number. It also had a parking permit sticker.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show registration information and the permit sticker. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: シールの番号と最後に見た時刻もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also give the sticker number and when you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨夜七時です。管理会社から返事が来たら、結果をこの相談にも追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最終時刻と管理会社回答の追加を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Seven last night. When management replies, I would like to add the result to this consultation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the last time and your plan to add management's response. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。連絡が取れた後の情報もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know what you learn after making contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封をする前のご確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking before sealing the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。書類の住所を一文字直しました。この訂正でも提出できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 訂正済み書類が受理されるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I corrected one character in the address on the document. Can it still be submitted with this correction?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a corrected document will be accepted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類を受理する条件は、提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please confirm document acceptance conditions with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここで送れることと、書類が認められることは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配送受付と提出条件を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So being able to send it here and having the document accepted are separate matters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish shipment acceptance from submission requirements. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。配送についてはご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We can advise about delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、提出先へ聞きます。料金を払うのはその後にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先へ確認するまで支払いを待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask the recipient now. I want to pay only after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait to pay until you check with the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。書類はこちらでお預かりせず、お手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go ahead. We will not hold the documents; please keep them with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話で新しい用紙へ書き直すよう言われました。今日はこのまま送れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書直しが必要との回答を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the phone I was told to rewrite it on a new form. I cannot send it as it is today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the answer that rewriting is required. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、封筒と書類をお持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then will you take the envelope and documents home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ち帰ります。書き直してから、宛先と同封物を点検して来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類を持帰り準備後再来すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After rewriting, I will check the address and enclosures and come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to take documents home and return after preparing them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができましたら配送方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Once ready, ask us about delivery methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この利用予定の欄について確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will check this intended-use field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎月最後に残るお金を書きました。三万円くらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 月末残額を利用予定に書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the money left at the end of each month. About thirty thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you wrote month-end money remaining as intended use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は今後の取引の見込みです。月末の残額とは別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field asks expected future transactions. That differs from the month-end balance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事の売上が入るので、入金はそれより多いです。売上と残る額を混ぜていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 売上入金と残額の違いに気付く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Business sales come in, so deposits are larger than that. I mixed up sales and the amount left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize the difference between sales deposits and remaining balance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのような入出金を予定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: What deposits and withdrawals do you expect?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 修理の仕事の代金を受け取り、部品代を支払います。月によって変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事の受取と支払の内容を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I receive payment for repair work and pay for parts. It varies by month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe business receipts and payments. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 固定額と決めず、分かる範囲の見込みを説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not decide it is a fixed amount. Explain the expectations as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最近の明細を参考にできますか。まだ確定していない注文を全部入れるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実績資料の利用と未確定注文の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Can I refer to recent statements? I want to avoid including all orders that are not confirmed yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about using actual records and handling unconfirmed orders. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が資料を確認して、この欄の書き方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will check the documents and explain how to fill this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。実績と予定を分けて、取引の範囲を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実績と見込みを分けて用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will separate actual results from plans and explain the scope of transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate actual results from expectations and state the use. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。用途を伺ったうえで必要な確認を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hear the intended use and proceed with necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この野菜にはバーコードがありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: These vegetables do not have a barcode.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。三個取りました。レジで三と入れればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: バーコードなし野菜の個数入力を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Right. I took three. Should I enter three at the register?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about entering quantity for vegetables without a barcode. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは重さで計算する商品です。個数だけでは価格が出ません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: These are priced by weight. Quantity alone does not determine the price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 棚の百円は一個の値段ではなかったんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示が個当たりでないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the hundred yen on the shelf was not the price per piece.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the display is not per item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 百グラム当たりの表示です。計量方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is per hundred grams. We will explain weighing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋の重さも一緒に料金になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋の重量処理を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Will the bag's weight be charged too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how bag weight is handled. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定の袋で計量する方法を担当が設定します。別の物は載せないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will set up weighing using the designated bag. Do not put other things on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋の中のメモは出します。野菜だけをこの指定袋で量ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 異物を出して指定袋で計量を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will remove the note inside the bag. Please weigh only the vegetables in this designated bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Remove other objects and request weighing in the designated bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 計量できました。この合計額になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Weighing is complete. This is the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額を確認しました。追加の一個は買わず、量った分でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 計量金額で購入量を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the price. I will not buy the extra one; just the weighed amount, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the purchase amount at the weighed price. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。計量済みの分をお会計に進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will proceed to payment for the weighed portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その小さいコーンは何にお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What are you using those small cones for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供の自転車練習です。道に並べて曲がる練習をさせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: コーンを置く練習目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child's bicycle practice. I want to line them up on the path to practise turning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the practice purpose for placing cones. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 園路はほかの方も通るので、練習用にふさがないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Other people use the park path too, so please do not block it for practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 人が少なくても置かないんですね。使える場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空いていても通路占有できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even if there are few people, I cannot put them there. Is there a place we can use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the passage cannot be occupied even when quiet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この公園で練習できる範囲は、管理棟で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check at the management building where practice is allowed in this park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ではコーンは箱に戻します。子供も自転車を押して管理棟へ連れて行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目印を片付け管理棟へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will put the cones back in the box. My child will push the bicycle, and we will go to the management building.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put away markers and head to the management building. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。歩行者へ道を譲ってください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は場所が確認できなければ乗る練習はやめます。歩いて回るだけなら大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習不可の場合の散歩利用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If we cannot confirm a place today, we will not practise riding. Would just walking around be okay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about walking if practice is unavailable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 散歩として園路をご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may use the park paths for a walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 練習と散歩を分けます。許可のない所には目印を置きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 許可確認まで練習をしないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep practice separate from walking. I will not place markers where permission has not been given.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide not to practise until permission is confirmed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。管理棟へはこちらからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11234-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please go this way to the management building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらへ戻られた理由を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask why you have returned here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗換のつもりで矢印を追い、改札を出てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗換中に誤って出場したと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I followed arrows thinking I was transferring, and accidentally went out through the ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you accidentally exited while transferring. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お使いの切符を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。まだ目的駅へ着いていません。もう一度そのまま入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符を示し再入場可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. I have not reached my destination yet. Can I enter again with it as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the ticket and ask whether re-entry is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符の種類と出場の記録を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the ticket type and exit record and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で新しい券を買う前に、誤って出たことを説明したかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 買直し前に事情確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I wanted to explain the accidental exit before buying a new ticket myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the circumstances before repurchasing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。乗換の経路も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Let's check the transfer route too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板の出口の矢印を、乗換の矢印だと思いました。次はどの表示を見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出口と乗換の矢印を混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I mistook the exit arrow on the sign for a transfer arrow. Which display should I look for next?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain you confused the exit and transfer arrows. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 路線名のある乗換案内です。この通路をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The transfer information with the line name. Please use this passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 路線名を確認します。切符の扱いが済んでから、案内された改札へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券の処理後に路線名の表示で進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the line name. After the ticket handling is complete, I will go to the gate you direct me to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed using the line-name sign after ticket processing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。こちらで確認後、入場方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. After checking here, we will explain how to enter.
